answer: Promotion is logged in cedar and vine recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 11 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the gale. A 306 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
